name: Entity Machine Name (emn)
description: Adds a 'Machine name' column to admin list tables for content types, vocabularies, roles and blocks.
project_description:
This module basically displays a machine name as a new column of each specific entities.

 Requirements: 
 
 Enable core module: User (enabled by default). 
 Enable core module: Block (enabled by default). 
 Enable core module: Taxonomy (enabled by default). 
 Enable core module: Node (enabled by default). 
 
 Setup: 
 No setup is required, the machine names are added in the overview pages, For example (/admin/structure/types).

 Similar Projects: 
 
 Roles Machine Name : This module only displays the machine name for roles page
